submitted.title: Recognize apps in nested folders
submitted.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Use the full member-relative path for each descriptor request, cache entry and shelf lookup. Keep folder navigation, focus and order stable as metadata arrives. Keep the existing request budget and concurrency limit.

**Related earlier work** · WI-032

**Delivery dependencies** · Can begin on the current PR head. 

**Verify** · Use two nested Weather folders in different parents and a root-level namesake. Verify distinct descriptors, app actions, malformed descriptor fallback, stable focus and the 12-probe and three-concurrent limits during input and navigation.

**Delivery** · v0.2 client, existing PR #9.
